subject: Computer Science

expected_agent_turn_1: Acknowledge the frustration and note that the logic appears correct on the surface. Affirm the diagnosis and ask them to propose an alternative strategy (e.g., iterating backwards, creating a new list, or using list comprehension). Ask a self-regulation question about how to recognize this specific mutable-iteration pattern in future code.
